title_cyr: Ја подај ми либе една чаша вино
title_latin: Ja podaj mi libe edna čaša vino
title_en: Please give me, my love, a glass of wine

lines.cyr: - Ја подај ми либе една чаша вино,
lines.lat: - Ja podaj mi libe edna čaša vino,
lines.en: - Please give me, my love, a glass of wine,
to drink, my love, please let me drink.

lines.cyr: - Ај на порти стои стариот татко
lines.lat: - Aj na porti stoi stariot tatko
lines.en: - Oh, the old father is standing at the gate
and watching, my love, he is watching.

lines.cyr: - На тебе татко, а на мене дедо,
lines.lat: - Na tebe tatko, a na mene dedo,
lines.en: - Both your father, and my grandfather,
they don't see, my love, they don't see.

lines.cyr: - Ај на порти стои мојата мајка
lines.lat: - Aj na porti stoi mojata majka
lines.en: - Oh, my mother is standing at the gate
and watching, my love, she is watching.

lines.cyr: - На тебе мајка, а на мене баба,
lines.lat: - Na tebe majka, a na mene baba,
lines.en: - Both your mother, and my grandmother,
they don't see, my love, they don't see.
